name: com.tencent.micro.MicroBaseActivity
description: This is Tencent TCR's shared screen foundation for cloud-hosted games, not a screen the app can open by itself. A concrete game screen supplied by the host app can use it to show the live game video, send player controls, reconnect, and manage updates.
disableEffect: Disabling this base declaration does not disable a separate game screen supplied by the app; this base component cannot be opened on its own.
